scope: offline immutable GGUF metadata/tensor-directory and exhaustive token-map comparison; no inference runtime imported or model executed

comparison.digest_format: per ascending ID: uint32-le ID, uint32-le UTF8 byte length, exact UTF8 symbol bytes
comparison.type_comparison_rule: target base=>NORMAL(1); added special=>CONTROL(3); added nonspecial=>USER_DEFINED(4)
comparison.merge_digest_format: per ascending rank: uint32-le rank, uint32-le UTF8 byte length, merge string bytes
comparison.qualification_limit: Exact raw symbols/types/merge ranks do not prove runtime pretokenization, NFC, added-token matching flags, decoding, chat/stop policy or call-option equivalence.

frozen_workload_membership.qualification: Existing frozen IDs pass the raw ID/symbol and type admission check, including their four matching added-token classes; none of the six mismatched classes occur. This does not qualify numerical models, execution, whole text tokenizer, future proposals, target acceptance or native injection.
